```bash
        # match level_N: "..." possibly multiline with |
        m = re.search(rf'^level_{i}:\s*(.+?)(?=\n(?:level_|[a-z_]+:)|$)', text, re.M | re.S)
        if m:
            val = m.group(1).strip()
            # strip quotes
            if val.startswith('"') and val.endswith('"'):
                val = val[1:-1]
            elif val.startswith("'") and val.endswith("'"):
                val = val[1:-1]
            levels[i] = val

            break
```

```bash
"""Heuristic audit: flag likely level-job mismatches for s/t notes."""
import re
from pathlib import Path

notes = sorted(Path('content/english/notes').glob('[st]*.md'))

def extract(text):
    out = {}
    for i in range(1,6):
        m = re.search(rf'^level_{i}:\s*"((?:\\.|[^"\\])*)"', text, re.M)
        if not m:
            m = re.search(rf"^level_{i}:\s*'((?:\\.|[^'\\])*)'", text, re.M)
        out[i] = m.group(1) if m else None
    return out

# Heuristics (imperfect):
# L1 should name/define - flags if starts with Like/analogy, or is pure application
# L2 OK with Like
# L3 should be situation/decision - flags if pure "Because"/tradeoff abstract or pure Pair with
# L4 should be systems - flags if "Run X" / "Ship" / concrete single action only, or pure Pair with as generative
# L5 should create/extend - flags if pure definition restatement, or only Because systems

issues = []
for p in notes:
    lv = extract(p.read_text())
    flags = []
    l1,l2,l3,l4,l5 = [lv[i] or '' for i in range(1,6)]
    
    # L1 analogy-only
    if re.match(r'^Like\b', l1, re.I):
        flags.append('L1_analogy')
    # L1 looks like application (imperative start)
    if re.match(r'^(Skip|Ask|Run|Open|Write|Ship|Tell|Sit|Pull|Call|Drop|Cut|Pick|Install|Map|Hit|Post|Empty|Tend|Sign|Compare|Audit|Pray|Invite|Name|Mark|Leave|Split|Get|Close|Quote|Move|Halt|Scribble|Walk|Swap|State|Drill|Tie|Opt|Architect|Redirect|Thank|Refuse|Goes|Deliver|Choose|Build|Unblock|Pace|Change|Compress|Spend|Stop|Trade)\b', l1):
        flags.append('L1_imperative')
    # L2 duplicates L1 heavily
    def tokens(s):
        return set(re.findall(r'[a-z]{4,}', s.lower()))
    t1,t2 = tokens(l1), tokens(l2)
    if t1 and t2 and len(t1 & t2)/max(len(t1),1) > 0.55 and len(t1)>8:
        flags.append('L1_L2_overlap')
    # L3 systems-y "Because"
    if re.match(r'^Because\b', l3):
        flags.append('L3_because')
    # L3 generative Pair with
    if re.match(r'^Pair with\b|^\[\[', l3):
        flags.append('L3_generative')
    # L4 application-y imperatives without tradeoff words
    tradeoff = re.search(r'\b(because|tradeoff|limit|when|implication|cost|vs|versus|hides|erodes|distorts|only|not only|before|after|without|unless|fails|beats|when)\b', l4, re.I)
    if re.match(r'^(Run|Ship|Write|Ask|Open|Hit|Post|Empty|Cut|Pick|Drill|Opt|Map|Tell|Sit)\b', l4) and not tradeoff:
        flags.append('L4_application')
    # L4 starts with Pair / [[ only - might be generative
```

```bash
"""Deeper job-role audit with human-readable flags."""
import re
from pathlib import Path

notes = sorted(Path('content/english/notes').glob('[st]*.md'))

def extract(text):
    out = {}
    for i in range(1,6):
        m = re.search(rf'^level_{i}:\s*"((?:\\.|[^"\\])*)"', text, re.M)
        out[i] = m.group(1) if m else ''
    return out

# Manual review notes keyed by patterns that violate jobs
print("=== Manual review candidates ===\n")

for p in notes:
    lv = extract(p.read_text())
    problems = []
    l1,l2,l3,l4,l5 = lv[1],lv[2],lv[3],lv[4],lv[5]

    # L5 looks like concrete one-shot application (Ship/Cut/Build/Run X before Y) without extend language
    if re.match(r'^(Ship|Cut|Build|Run|Write|Ask|Open|Hit|Post|Empty|Tell|Sit|Pull|Call|Drop|Map|Hit|Name|Mark|Leave|Split|Get|Close|Quote|Move|Walk|State|Drill|Tie|Audit|Pray|Invite|Compare|Tend|Sign)\b', l5):
        if not re.search(r'\[\[', l5) and not re.search(r'\b(same|extend|create|pair|architect|install|aim|use the|contribute)\b', l5, re.I):
            problems.append('L5_looks_application')

    # L4 looks like imperative application without systems framing
    if re.match(r'^(Write|Run|Ship|Ask|Open|Hit|Post|Empty|Cut|Pick|Drill|Opt|Map|Tell|Sit|Name|Mark|Split|Get|Close|Quote|Move|Walk|State|Tie|Audit|Pray|Invite|Compare|Tend|Sign|Skip)\b', l4):
        if not re.search(r'\b(because|when|before|after|limit|tradeoff|cost|vs|without|unless|fails|beats|hides|only|distorts|erodes|needs|guarantees|produces|settles|asks|reveals|implication)\b', l4, re.I):
            problems.append('L4_looks_application')

    # L3 and L4 token overlap high
    def tok(s):
        return set(re.findall(r'[a-z]{5,}', s.lower()))
    o = tok(l3) & tok(l4)
    if len(o) >= 4 and len(o)/max(len(tok(l3)|tok(l4)),1) > 0.35:
        problems.append(f'L3_L4_overlap({sorted(o)[:6]})')

    # L1 and L2 overlap
    o12 = tok(l1) & tok(l2)
    if len(o12) >= 5 and len(o12)/max(len(tok(l1)|tok(l2)),1) > 0.4:
        problems.append(f'L1_L2_overlap({sorted(o12)[:6]})')

    # L5 restates L1 (high overlap, low generative)
    o15 = tok(l1) & tok(l5)
    if len(o15) >= 4 and len(o15)/max(len(tok(l1)|tok(l5)),1) > 0.35:
        if not re.search(r'\[\[', l5):
            problems.append(f'L5_restates_L1({sorted(o15)[:6]})')

    # L4 is mostly "Pair with" / link-lead without systems clause
    if re.match(r'^(Pair with|\[\[)', l4):
        # check if there's systems content after
        if not re.search(r'\b(because|when|limit|tradeoff|needs|fails|vs|without|before|after|hides|erodes|guarantees|shows what|settles)\b', l4, re.I):
            problems.append('L4_link_only')

    # L3 is "Like" analogy - wrong job
    if re.match(r'^Like\b', l3):
        problems.append('L3_analogy')

    # L2 is imperative application
    if re.match(r'^(Skip|Ask|Run|Open|Write|Ship|Tell|Sit|Pull|Call|Drop|Cut|Pick|Install|Map|Hit|Post|Empty)\b', l2):
        problems.append('L2_application')

    if problems:
        print(f"{p.name}")
        for pr in problems:
            print(f"  - {pr}")
        print(f"  L3: {l3[:100]}")
        print(f"  L4: {l4[:100]}")
```

from pathlib import Path
import re

NOTES = Path(&#39;content/english/notes&#39;)

def set_level(text, n, value):
    &#34;&#34;&#34;Replace level_n quoted string.&#34;&#34;&#34;
    pat = rf&#39;(^level_{n}:\s*)&#34;(?:\\.|[^&#34;\\])*&#34;&#39;
    repl = rf&#39;\1&#34;{value}&#34;&#39;
    new, count = re.subn(pat, repl, text, count=1, flags=re.M)
    if count != 1:
        raise SystemExit(f&#39;level_{n} replace failed&#39;)
    return new

def insert_kc_after_claim(text, bullets):
    &#34;&#34;&#34;Insert bullets after first claim bullet in key_concept (skip bible blocks).&#34;&#34;&#34;
    # Find key_concept block
    m = re.search(r&#39;^key_concept:\s*\|\s*\n&#39;, text, re.M)
    if not m:
        raise SystemExit(&#39;no key_concept&#39;)
    start = m.end()
    # Find level_1 start
    m2 = re.search(r&#39;^level_1:&#39;, text[start:], re.M)
    if not m2:
        raise SystemExit(&#39;no level_1 after kc&#39;)
    kc_body = text[start:start+m2.start()]
    lines = kc_body.splitlines(keepends=True)
    
    # Find insertion point: after first real claim bullet (not bible, not blank, not explanation after bible that starts with - and follows shortcode)
    # Strategy: walk lines; after we see first &#39;- &#39; claim that is not empty, insert after it (and after following blank if any? insert right after that bullet line)
    insert_at = None
    i = 0
    while i &lt; len(lines):
        raw = lines[i]
        stripped = raw.strip()
        if stripped.startswith(&#39;{{&lt;&#39;):
            i += 1
            continue
        if stripped == &#39;&#39;:
            i += 1
            continue
        if stripped.startswith(&#39;- &#39;):
            insert_at = i + 1
            break
        i += 1
    if insert_at is None:
        raise SystemExit(&#39;no claim bullet found&#39;)
    
    # Avoid duplicating if bullet text already present
    kc_flat = &#39;&#39;.join(lines)
    new_lines = []
    for b in bullets:
        if b.strip().lstrip(&#39;- &#39;).strip() in kc_flat:
            continue
        new_lines.append(f&#39;  - {b}\n&#39; if not b.startswith(&#39;- &#39;) else f&#39;  {b}\n&#39; if not b.startswith(&#39;  &#39;) else b if b.endswith(&#39;\n&#39;) else b+&#39;\n&#39;)
        # normalize
    # cleaner:
    to_add = []
    for b in bullets:
        content = b[2:] if b.startswith(&#39;- &#39;) else b
        if content in kc_flat:
            continue
        to_add.append(f&#39;  - {content}\n&#39;)
    
    if not to_add:
        return text  # nothing to add
    
    lines[insert_at:insert_at] = to_add
    new_kc = &#39;&#39;.join(lines)
    return text[:start] + new_kc + text[start+m2.start():]

fixes = {}

```bash
cd /home/jorap/Documents/GitHub/jorap.com && python3 << 'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re

NOTES = Path('content/english/notes')

def set_level(text, n, value):
    """Replace level_n quoted string."""
    pat = rf'(^level_{n}:\s*)"(?:\\.|[^"\\])*"'
    repl = rf'\1"{value}"'
    new, count = re.subn(pat, repl, text, count=1, flags=re.M)
    if count != 1:
        raise SystemExit(f'level_{n} replace failed')
    return new

def insert_kc_after_claim(text, bullets):
    """Insert bullets after first claim bullet in key_concept (skip bible blocks)."""
    # Find key_concept block
    m = re.search(r'^key_concept:\s*\|\s*\n', text, re.M)
    if not m:
        raise SystemExit('no key_concept')
    start = m.end()
    # Find level_1 start
    m2 = re.search(r'^level_1:', text[start:], re.M)
    if not m2:
        raise SystemExit('no level_1 after kc')
    kc_body = text[start:start+m2.start()]
    lines = kc_body.splitlines(keepends=True)
    
    # Find insertion point: after first real claim bullet (not bible, not blank, not explanation after bible that starts with - and follows shortcode)
    # Strategy: walk lines; after we see first '- ' claim that is not empty, insert after it (and after following blank if any? insert right after that bullet line)
    insert_at = None
    i = 0
    while i < len(lines):
        raw = lines[i]
        stripped = raw.strip()
        if stripped.startswith('{{<'):
            i += 1
            continue
        if stripped == '':
            i += 1
            continue
        if stripped.startswith('- '):
            insert_at = i + 1
            break
        i += 1
    if insert_at is None:
        raise SystemExit('no claim bullet found')
    
    # Avoid duplicating if bullet text already present
    kc_flat = ''.join(lines)
    new_lines = []
    for b in bullets:
        if b.strip().lstrip('- ').strip() in kc_flat:
            continue
        new_lines.append(f'  - {b}\n' if not b.startswith('- ') else f'  {b}\n' if not b.startswith('  ') else b if b.endswith('\n') else b+'\n')
        # normalize
    # cleaner:
    to_add = []
    for b in bullets:
        content = b[2:] if b.startswith('- ') else b
        if content in kc_flat:
            continue
        to_add.append(f'  - {content}\n')
    
    if not to_add:
        return text  # nothing to add
    
    lines[insert_at:insert_at] = to_add
    new_kc = ''.join(lines)
    return text[:start] + new_kc + text[start+m2.start():]
```

```

=== FINAL LEVELS ===

sabbath-for-good.md
  L1: Sabbath for good means rest serves people and mercy - not rule-keeping for show.
  L2: The Sabbath was made for man, not man for the Sabbath - the Lord of the Sabbath chose healing over empty performance religion.
  L3: Skip rigid rule theater when a teammate is stranded - mercy beats quoting your off day policy.
  L4: Because legalism turns gift into gauge, binding the bent woman was the real sin, not healing on the Sabbath.
  L5: Pair with [[Heart Righteousness]] and [[Secret Devotion]] - refuse piety for applause.

self-control.md
  L1: Self-control is choosing the next move on purpose instead of letting the urge drive.
  L2: Spirit-grown restraint, not a merit streak - urge proposes, you decide under pressure.
  L3: Close the app and answer when you are not drunk on cortisol - not the snarky reply in the group chat.
  L4: Because autopilot favors the loudest impulse, deliberate selection beats suppression theater.
  L5: Extend the same restraint across surfaces - [[Fruits of the Spirit]] holds the faith lane; this note is the general skill you can run anywhere.

selling-static-sites.md
  L1: Selling static sites means charging for the build and pass-off - margin lives in labor, not hosting markup.
  L2: Static hosting is a minimal cost - the sale is craftsmanship and transfer, not inflated infra bills resold monthly.
```
